---
title: "Forecast-guided stewardship cost-effectiveness analysis"
format: html
execute: {echo: true, warning: false}
---

This is the one-year CEA. It reports costs, QALYs and net monetary benefit for the
2026 forecast target. It does not claim to be a formal budget-impact analysis.

```{r}
source("R/run_economic_analysis.R")
summary <- read.csv("outputs/economic_r/psa_summary.csv")
correlation <- read.csv("outputs/economic_r/correlation_sensitivity.csv")
summary
correlation
```

The intervention is molecular rapid diagnostic testing from a positive blood
culture plus active, real-time stewardship review. The published mortality odds
ratio is sampled lognormally. All other evidence classifications are visible in
`parameters/economic_parameters.csv`. Results are illustrative, not a policy
recommendation.
